xpNote: Pets need only ~25% of the XP a player needs, so a 19 can level a full pet stable within budget. Pets gain NO XP from quest turn-ins — only the player does. Sync pets to your level BEFORE turning in gear quests or you'll out-level them.
abilityNote: Ability-shop while taming: tame temporary pets to learn ability ranks (e.g. Bite Rank 3, Claw Rank 3) before taming the keeper — learned abilities persist on the hunter.
budgetNote: At level 18 with three level-18 pets you have roughly a 6,000 XP surplus for the few required gear quests before hitting 19. Sync pets first, then turn in.
